## 2026

**Decompression melting of peridotite xenoliths.**
**W. H. Towbin** and T. Plank. *Journal of Petrology* 67(9), egag077.
[doi:10.1093/petrology/egag077](https://doi.org/10.1093/petrology/egag077)

> Micro-CT, electron microprobe and diffusion modeling show that mantle rocks carried up by magma start melting during a rise of one to three weeks. [Plain-language summary](posts/2026%20Xenolith%20Melting/index.qmd).

**High precision water quantification by Raman spectroscopy: Applications to volcanic and extraterrestrial samples.**
E. G. Huggins, E. Gazel, M. Gavrilenko, K. Dayton, J. D. Bixler, **W. H. Towbin** and T. Plank. *Chemical Geology* 721, 123628.
[doi:10.1016/j.chemgeo.2026.123628](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chemgeo.2026.123628)

## 2023

**Measuring H₂O concentrations in olivine by secondary ion mass spectrometry: Challenges and paths forward.**
**W. H. Towbin**, T. Plank, E. Klein and E. Hauri. *American Mineralogist* 108(5), 928–940.
[doi:10.2138/am-2022-8247](https://doi.org/10.2138/am-2022-8247)

> Two sets of reference standards that most labs use to measure water in olivine disagree by about 50%. We traced the offset to the reference values and proposed a calibration that avoids it. [Summary](posts/2023%20Water%20in%20Olivine/index.qmd).

**Rates of dehydration in hydrous, high-Fo, magmatic olivines.**
A. Barth, T. Plank and **W. H. Towbin**. *Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta* 342, 62–73.
[doi:10.1016/j.gca.2022.11.009](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gca.2022.11.009)
